messages:
Aisha: Hey folks — kicking off a quick preflight for the APAC PrivateHub onboarding with partner CloudHarbor. Need quota, KMS, marketplace entitlement, and peering checks. Target go-live: 2026-05-10. Please flag blockers.
Dan: Thanks Aisha. Quick status: partner has signed MSA, marketplace listing draft is with legal. We need GPU quota: 60 T4-equivalent (initial), and 2 KMS key wraps/sec estimated.
Priya: Can we get SKUs and node counts? CloudHarbor expects T4 and A100 fallback options.
Rohan: From infra: we recommend starting with 16 x T4 (4 pools x 4 nodes), which maps to ~64 vGPUs. I'll submit a quota request to cloud ops for ap-southeast4 today.
Marta: Security: requirement is HSM-backed KMS, customer-managed key (BYOK) with cross-project grants. We still need CloudHarbor SOC2 docs before we enable production keys.
Dan: I'll ping the partner for SOC docs and KMS owner contact.
Aisha: Marketplace note — partner requests a private listing + a "Redwood Dedicated" SKU variant for their offering. Legal ok with draft?
Priya: Legal asked for the listing copy; forwarding now. Also need the billing mapping for the SKU.
ops-bot: capacity-bot: quota request created: ticket CH-4821, status: pending. ETA ~48h.
Rohan: For the quota ticket, please include this block so cloud ops can auto-approve quicker:
```
project: redwood-apac-prod
region: ap-southeast4
resource: nvidia-t4
quota: 64
justification: "Initial production pool for Redwood Dedicated - partner CloudHarbor"
```
Priya: I'll own the marketplace entitlement test plan. Checklist items: access mapping, billing, KMS flow, canary routing, observability hooks. Posting EOD.
Dan: Partner asked about SLA for Dedicated. We typically offer 99.9%. Ops: can we commit to a 4hr P1 for initial 3 months?
Rohan: 4hr P1 is doable with oncall adjustments; need SRE sign-off and documented runbook. Tagging Marta for runbook security sign-off.
Marta: We can provisionally sign off on 4hr P1 if runbook includes contact matrix, escalation steps, and KMS compromise procedure.
Aisha: Collating blockers: 1) KMS SOC docs, 2) quota ticket CH-4821, 3) marketplace draft approval, 4) partner billing onboarding. Anything else?
Dan: Network peering approvals — if partner uses private VPC peering it may add ~2 weeks. Start early.
Priya: Scheduling a partner call tomorrow 10:00 SGT to collect SOC, KMS ARN, billing contact. Dan please add agenda.
Dan: Added agenda: SOC doc, KMS ARNs, quota confirmation, marketplace SKU, peering next steps. Invite includes CloudHarbor (alec@cloudharbor.io).
Aisha: Good. If quota auto-approves, aim to provision infra within 72h of approval.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: reminder — attach CH-4821 to the region runbook after approval.
Priya: Posting checklist link when ready: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/apac/privatehub-checklist
Aisha: Follow-ups assigned: Dan -> partner docs, Rohan -> quota submit + SRE approval, Priya -> checklist & marketplace test plan, Marta -> runbook sign-off. Meeting tomorrow 10:00 SGT. :thumbsup:
Dan: On it.
Rohan: Moving the quota ticket now.
Marta: Will review runbook once draft posted.
Priya: See you all tomorrow.
